suggested_questions: Tell me about yourself and your background.
What would you say are your greatest strengths?
Describe a time you worked in a team project — what was your role?
Have you ever led a group or project? How did you handle it?
Tell me about a disagreement with a teammate and how you resolved it.
Describe a mistake you made on a project and what you learned from it.
Why are you interested in this role, and where do you see yourself growing?
